name: Rikorisu ~Lycoris Radiata~
source: After questioning his path in life, Touwa embarks on a soul-searching journey across the open sea. Stranded under the scorching sun with no wind, his desperate prayers for relief are answered by a sudden storm that leaves him shipwrecked on an uncharted island. There, he discovers a mansion inhabited by three sister maids who offer him shelter as he works to repair his ship and continue his journey.
translation: 对人生道路产生疑问后，藤和踏上横渡大海的寻心之旅。烈日当空、海面无风，他被困在船上，绝望地祈求解脱。突如其来的暴风雨回应了祈愿，却令船只失事，把他送到一座无名岛屿。在那里，他发现了一座宅邸，里面住着3名女仆姐妹。她们为藤和提供栖身之处，让他能够修好船只，继续旅程。
